objections.claim: the anti-p19 antibodies mirikizumab, risankizumab and guselkumab, which bind IL12B and block interleukin-23 only
objections.objection: Anti-p19 antibodies bind the p19 subunit of IL-23 (IL23A), not IL12B (p40); binding p40 would block IL-12 too, contradicting 'block interleukin-23 only'.
objections.suggestion: Write 'which bind IL23A (p19) and block interleukin-23 only'.
objections.quote: Risankizumab, mirikizumab, and guselkumab - three monoclonal antibodies targeting the p19 subunit of IL-23 - have each completed Phase 3 clinical development programs in both Crohn's disease (CD) and ulcerative colitis (UC), demonstrating consistent efficacy across a broad spectrum of disease severity.

objections.claim: IL12B is the p19 subunit of interleukin-12 and interleukin-23
objections.objection: IL12B encodes p40, the subunit shared by IL-12 and IL-23; p19 is IL23A and belongs to IL-23 only.
objections.suggestion: Write 'IL12B is the p40 subunit of interleukin-12 and interleukin-23'.
objections.quote: Ustekinumab is a monoclonal antibody binding the shared p40 subunit of IL-12 and IL-23, and the inhibition of these two cytokines, implicated in host response to microbial pathogens, has demonstrated clinical efficacy in different immune-mediated diseases, including moderate-to-severe UC.

objections.claim: which shows that blocking interleukin-12 is required
objections.objection: Contradicts the paragraph's own facts: anti-p19 antibodies block IL-23 only and were effective, so IL-12 blockade is not required; the next clause also says the IL-12 question is unsettled.
objections.suggestion: Write 'which shows that blocking interleukin-23 alone is enough'.

objections.objection: Upadacitinib is a selective JAK1 inhibitor, not JAK2-selective; the card's own drug tag says JAK1-selective.
objections.quote: Upadacitinib is a selective Janus kinase-1 (JAK1) inhibitor approved for the treatment of moderate-to-severe ulcerative colitis (UC) and Crohn's disease (CD).

objections.objection: Nangibotide is an investigational TREM-1 modulator tested in septic shock, where its phase 2b missed the primary endpoint; it is not approved for UC (the card's tag itself says phase 2, covid-19).
objections.suggestion: Remove the approval claim; say nangibotide, a TREM-1 modulator, has only been tested outside UC (sepsis, phase 2) and is not a UC drug.
objections.quote: This trial did not achieve the primary outcome of improvement in SOFA score at the predefined sTREM-1 value.

objections.objection: The card itself says the change is partly composition with no response or functional data; calling a first-in-class hypothesis 'validated' is misleading and clashes with the block's 'hypotheses to test'.
